The image appears to be AI-generated or heavily processed, showing significant texture anomalies.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The stock merges into the receiver in a physically impossible way, lacking any hinge, pin, or separation line. The geometry collapses into a single blob.
The pistol grip is formed, but the trigger is completely missing. There is only a smooth curve where the trigger guard and trigger should be.
The magazine appears to be fused to the side of the receiver rather than inserted into a well. The boundaries between the two components are blurred and indistinct.
The surface lacks the sharp specular highlights expected of metal. It has a waxy, smeared appearance typical of diffusion model artifacts on hard-surface objects.
